summary: First-party Haitian sources were inspected with browser-like headers and TLS verification. No safe public parcel service, native parcel identity, parcel schema, CRS, or polygon geometry was verified. No GeoJSON sample is retained; runtime remains held.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and French/Haitian-Creole queries, exact text, outcomes, and actual first-party URLs are recorded in city-1133-port-de-paix.json.
requestOutcomes: IHSI, DGI, SIA Haiti, and the Port-de-Paix municipal site returned HTTP 200 but exposed no parcel service; SIA exposed only administrative/environmental GeoJSON routes. CIAT returned HTTP 503. No login, credentials, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe field request, or TLS exception was used.
scopeLimits: Exact WUP point [19.9413175024373, -72.7770244434136] and population fields were preserved; the point was not shifted and no exact-point parcel test was attempted.
SIA administrative/environmental boundaries are not cadastral parcels and were not retained as samples.
No public parcel identity, native field mapping, CRS, geometry response, or composite parcel key was obtained; no synthetic identity or geometry was created.
CIAT HTTP 503 and absent public routes are not evidence of citywide cadastral absence.
No owner, address, titleholder, contact, tax/account, personal, or other unsafe fields were requested or retained.
Packet completion is research evidence only and does not qualify or admit a runtime adapter.
safeFieldAllowlist: full parcel polygon geometry if returned
compositeKeyProvenance: No parcel response was obtained; no composite key was constructed.
geometryQuality: not evaluated; no parcel geometry retrieved
